## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior or decision. Name the specification
and milestone, using “v0.3 M0” etc. for the new sequence.

## Scope and status

Identify proposals, accepted decisions and any migration of existing work.
State unresolved architecture choices and any separate approval still needed.

## Validation

List acceptance criteria covered and evidence: automated tests for implementation,
documentation/link review for design changes, and any limits of validation.

## Preservation

Explain how prior work and history are preserved. Identify any changes affecting
runtime data, external services or deployment and their authorization.

## Architecture boundary

- [ ] Uses the current event-driven baseline (ADR-004), with no PARA/Obsidian or legacy markos dependency.
- [ ] Distinguishes archived regression evidence from independent runtime acceptance.
- [ ] Records proposed versus accepted choices; includes no merge/deployment or personal-data migration without scope.
